scope: Pure presentation/input rules only, no accepted HTTP32 or clinical result

results.case: Civil dates validate leap years instead of normalizing impossible days
Civil arithmetic receives server dates and handles years below100
Query defaults remain server authority and one bound is not guessed
Query enforces inclusive62 and never manufactures a future observation
Measurement requires an explicit profile and at least one value
Measurement retains exact units and does not derive lean mass
Booleans, nonfinite numbers and ambiguous unit strings are rejected
Existing technical weight/bodyfat/lean bounds are not clinical targets
Measurement cannot silently adopt a future declared date
Consent categories default to no grant unless explicitly selected
Consent fixed future dates are permitted independently of query62days
Ongoing permission requires both explicit true and explicit null end
Sharing body measurements requires personal profile; completion alone does not adopt one
Observed completion has an explicit denominator and zero means unavailable ratio
A source menu does not generate consumed/completed counts
Series never turns historical storage dates into declared measurement dates
Sparse real observations remain sparse, with declared units and no interpolation
One date, withdrawn records and missing metric do not create a trend
A displayed legacy profile is not upgraded into authority for a new record or grant
